dimensions.assessment: Affects federal management agencies, state and tribal partners, and members of the public utilizing federal waterways for recreation.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Forest Service and the Department of the Interior to standardize and publish data relating to the public's access to federal waterways for recreational use.

dimensions.assessment: Improves public access information and standardization without altering existing waterway definitions or management jurisdiction.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this Act-- (1) modifies or alters the definition of the term 'navigable waters' under Federal law

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for data digitization and interagency standardization, though specific spending figures are not detailed.
dimensions.evidence: may (1) coordinate and partner with nonfederal agencies, private entities, and nonprofit partners; and (2) enter into agreements with third parties.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates interagency data standardization, GIS mapping, regular updates, and annual reporting across multiple federal departments.
dimensions.evidence: jointly develop and adopt interagency standards to ensure compatibility and interoperability among applicable Federal databases

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent data maintenance and updating requirements alongside annual reports extending through March 30, 2034.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter through March 30, 2034, the Secretaries shall submit a report

missing_information: Exact budgetary allocations required to execute the data standardization and publication are omitted.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs federal land and water management agencies to standardize, digitize, and publish public recreational access data for federal waterways over a multi-year period.
